name: OwlyCrackGeo
author: owlybot

sections.description:
OwlyCrackGeo is an all-in-one, privacy-first, lightweight WordPress analytics, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and firewall plugin designed specifically for the Generative AI era. Like a vigilant owl watching over your site at night, OwlyCrackGeo keeps track of every bot, AI crawler, and visitor 24/7.

Track, analyze, and control visits from 60+ major AI bots, LLM crawlers, and AI search engines (such as OpenAI GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, Anthropic ClaudeBot, DeepSeekBot, ByteDance Bytespider, Kimi/Moonshot, Qwen, Google-Extended, Applebot, Perplexity, and more) — while comparing AI traffic with real human visitor trends.

🌟 Key Features

  • Real-time AI Bot Detection & Fingerprinting: Detects 60+ major international and domestic AI bots out of the box with zero configuration.
  • Native IndexNow Instant AI Indexing: Automatically broadcasts published or updated URLs to Bing and ChatGPT Search via the open IndexNow protocol for rapid crawl and citation freshness.
  • Unified Commercial Analytics Dashboard: 3-Tab unified workflow (Overview & Funnel, Crawler Activity & Defense, Citation Growth & Opportunities).
  • 4-Stage AI Conversion Funnel: Track conversion from Total Site PV ➔ AI Bot Crawls ➔ Real Human AI Referrals ➔ Citation Capture Rate.
  • Brand Prompt Hub & Live AI Penetration Links: Curated prompt templates with dynamic {brand} placeholder and instant live search tests in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and DeepSeek.
  • BLUF (Bottom Line Up Front) Content Readiness: AI-first answer density scoring prioritizing bold facts and signal takeaways in above-the-fold content.
  • Citation Gap & Opportunities Analysis: 4-quadrant insights into high-crawl zero-referral content gaps to prioritize high-ROI optimization.
  • Competitor Comparison (vs-Table) Diagnosis: Automated structural detection of comparison tables to win recommendation blocks in generative search.
  • AI Search Citation SERP Simulator: Preview in real time how your articles look when cited in Perplexity and ChatGPT Search.
  • 10-Dimensional AEO & GEO Content Scorer: Evaluates post structure, readability, FAQ schemas, and citation readiness for generative search engines.
  • Fake Bot FCrDNS Verification: Verifies incoming crawler IPs via forward-confirmed reverse DNS (FCrDNS) to detect and block malicious impostors.
  • Global GeoIP with CDN Header Sniffing: Fast, local IP resolution with native Cloudflare (CF-IPCountry), CloudFront, and Nginx GeoIP detection for 60+ countries.
  • AI Referral Traffic Tracking: Automatically records real human visitors clicking in from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Doubao, and Kimi.
  • AI Traffic vs Human Traffic Comparison: Understand your site’s true audience. Measure total site PV, human visitors, and your real-time AI Traffic Share (%).
  • Modern Canvas Analytics Dashboard: Interactive time-series trend line charts, AI vendor market share donut charts, and 24-hour crawling peak hourly distributions.
  • Dynamic Robots.txt Rule Management: Declare custom Allow / Disallow rules for individual AI crawlers without manually editing server configuration files.
  • Automated Anti-AI Training Meta Tags: Injects <meta name="robots" content="noai, noimageai"> and <meta name="tdm-reservation" content="1"> headers automatically.
  • Privacy-First & GDPR Compliant: No cookies, no personal data collection, zero third-party external dependencies, fully self-hosted within your WordPress database.

External services

OwlyCrackGeo is architected with a privacy-first, self-hosted design. All traffic statistics, bot detection heuristics, GEO analytics, and AEO evaluations are computed locally inside your WordPress database without relying on mandatory external SaaS processing.

In full compliance with WordPress.org guidelines, the following external interactions and user-initiated services are disclosed:

  1. Forward-Confirmed Reverse DNS (FCrDNS) Verification

* What the service is and what it is used for: Standard DNS PTR and A record lookups used to verify whether incoming crawlers claiming to be legitimate search bots (e.g. OpenAI GPTBot, Anthropic ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Bingbot) are authentic or malicious impersonators.
* What data is sent and when: When a request claims a verified bot User-Agent, an asynchronous DNS lookup (gethostbyaddr / gethostbynamel) is executed through the web server’s system DNS resolver. Only the crawler’s IP address and verified hostname are processed; no visitor personal data or site content is sent.
* Terms and Privacy: Governed by the server’s local network/DNS provider policies.

  1. User-Initiated AI Search Verification Links (Brand Prompt Hub & SERP Simulator)

* What the service is and what it is used for: Shortcut links in the admin interface allowing webmasters to test how their site and brand appear in leading AI search engines.
* What data is sent and when: Only when an administrator explicitly clicks a test button in the admin dashboard, the browser opens a new tab navigating to the respective AI search provider with the target search query in the URL parameter. No automated or server-to-server data transmission occurs.
* Third-Party Services and Legal Policies:
* OpenAI (ChatGPT / SearchGPT): Used for search citation verification.
* Terms of Use
* Privacy Policy
* Perplexity AI: Used for real-time generative answer preview.
* Terms of Service
* Privacy Policy
* Anthropic (Claude): Used for AI conversational retrieval testing.
* Commercial Terms of Service
* Privacy Policy
* DeepSeek: Used for open-weight model retrieval testing.
* Terms of Service
* Privacy Policy

  1. IndexNow Instant Indexing Protocol (api.indexnow.org)

* What the service is and what it is used for: Open standard protocol for notifying search engines (including Microsoft Bing, Yandex, and AI Search indexes such as ChatGPT Search) immediately when website content is published, updated, or deleted.
* What data is sent and when: When a post is published or updated (or when manually submitted via the admin dashboard), a JSON payload containing the site host, public key verification URL, and target post URL list is transmitted to https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow. No visitor personal data or user cookies are transmitted.
* Terms and Privacy:
* IndexNow Specification & Terms
* Microsoft Privacy Statement

  1. Telemetry & Phone-Home Code Status

* OwlyCrackGeo does not connect to any remote telemetry, phone-home, or data collection servers. All analytics and diagnostic logs remain exclusively on your local server.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/owlycrackgeo directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the OwlyCrackGeo menu in the admin sidebar to view real-time AI crawler statistics, analyze referral traffic, and manage your robots.txt firewall rules.
sections.faq:
Does OwlyCrackGeo affect my site’s frontend loading speed?

No. OwlyCrackGeo operates with minimal overhead (less than 1ms per request) during request processing. Visitor and crawler tracking is handled purely server-side with zero visible HTML rendering and zero external client-side scripts, ensuring maximum frontend performance.

How does OwlyCrackGeo distinguish real AI bots from malicious impostors?

OwlyCrackGeo integrates two-layer verification: User-Agent pattern matching followed by asynchronous Forward-Confirmed reverse DNS (FCrDNS) lookup for major vendors (such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Bing). Verified crawlers receive a verified badge; impostors are flagged and can be blocked automatically.

Can I block specific AI bots from scraping my site?

Yes. Simply navigate to OwlyCrackGeo > Settings & Firewall, check the bots you wish to restrict, and save. Those bots will immediately receive a 403 Forbidden response.
sections.changelog:
1.5.0

  • Added Native IndexNow Instant AI Indexing Engine for Bing & ChatGPT Search.
  • Automated post publishing and update hook listeners with debounce and duplicate protection.
  • Dual-layer key verification support (physical root file fallback to dynamic virtual routing).
  • Real-time submission logs stream and manual instant push console in Citation Growth tab.
  • Full bilingual internationalization for IndexNow status, notifications, and settings.
  • Disclosed IndexNow protocol in compliance with WordPress.org External Services guidelines.

1.4.2

  • Fixed internationalization in AI readiness diagnostic modal for score projections and step definitions.
  • Added complete database, transients, and options cleanup in uninstall.php.
  • Hardened user capability checks across bulk recalculation actions.
  • Cleaned up unused script dependencies and optimized dashboard bundle size.

1.4.1

  • Resolved WordPress.org Plugin Review Team audit compliance items.
  • Strictly prefixed all global functions, classes, and constants.
  • Enforced JSON-LD hex escaping and administrative capability callbacks.
  • Disclosed FCrDNS reverse lookups and live AI testing links in external services documentation.

1.4.0

  • Added Unified Commercial Dashboard (3-Tab workflow: Overview & Funnel, Crawler Activity & Defense, Citation Growth & Opportunities).
  • Added 4-Stage AI Conversion Funnel (Total PV ➔ AI Crawls ➔ AI Referrals ➔ Citation Rate).
  • Added Brand Prompt Hub with 4 preset industry templates, dynamic {brand} replacement, and live penetration links.
  • Added BLUF (Bottom Line Up Front) conclusion-first scoring algorithm with visual readiness card.
  • Added Citation Gap & Opportunities 4-quadrant analysis (Gaps, Champions, Nurturing).
  • Added Competitor Comparison (vs-Table) structured diagnosis.
  • Enhanced REST API resilience with dynamic port alignment, credentials handling, and auto-refreshing Nonce.
  • Completed bilingual internationalization (POT/MO compiled with 0 warnings).

1.3.0

  • Added AI Citation SERP Simulator with live Perplexity and ChatGPT Search preview cards.
  • Upgraded GeoIP engine with Cloudflare/CDN header auto-detection and 60+ global countries.
  • Added Fake Bot (FCrDNS) verification and impostor defense metrics to dashboard.
  • Added 10-dimensional AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) site health diagnostic engine.
  • Added AI referral tracking for human visitors arriving from ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, etc.
  • Standardized llms.txt, Markdown content negotiation, and GDPR privacy compliance.

1.1.0

  • Rebranded to OwlyCrackGeo with brand-new official mascot assets and 24/7 night watch aesthetics.
  • Added high-performance server-side human visitor tracking and AI traffic share (%) ratio analysis.
  • Added instant multilingual switcher engine with automatic instant reload.
  • Fully localized all AI bots metadata in English and Simplified Chinese.
  • Improved database schema self-healing on initialization.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Real-time detection of AI bots and LLM search crawlers.
  • Interactive Canvas dashboards and dark/light mode toggle.
  • Dynamic robots.txt injection and anti-AI training meta tags.
  • Detailed request logging with CSV export.
